title: Model load phases and page heap as the Airplane Mode DevTools panel shows them (Sprint 3)

commit.note: No commit hash was recorded. The run was made on the Sprint 3 working tree on top of 15c6d58; that tree was committed on 2026-11-14 (021d03d to 0562f24).

machine.label: Apple M5 Pro 48 GB
machine.browser: Chrome/157.0.8103.79 (installed, Playwright channel "chrome", headed DevTools window)

method: The spec loads SmolLM2-135M (q4) on forced WebAssembly with the engine in a worker, opens the real Chrome DevTools window with the unpacked extension, and reads the panel text. The five phase durations are the model.load.phase events under one load id; the page heap rows are performance.memory at before_load, after_session and after_first_token (the worker rows are null: Chrome exposes none). The acquire phase includes the download of 212,926,670 B from the loopback server.

files.name: devtools-figures.json
redactions: The Chrome unpacked-extension id (derived from the local install path, which contains the user name) is replaced by <redacted-extension-id> in extensionId and panelSelection. The embedded json is that redacted copy; sha256 is the hash of the unredacted original bytes in the workspace, so it will not match the bytes shown here.
